svg.aria-label: 2 rows, 1 per phase. Phase 0 uses columns 0 and 1 of A and rows 0 and 1 of B, s = 0 and 1; thread (0, 0) reads rows 0 and 1 of that part of A and columns 0 and 1 of that part of B. Its 4 sums go from 0 0 / 0 0 to 1 2 / 5 6. Phase 1 uses columns 2 and 3 of A and rows 2 and 3 of B, s = 2 and 3, and adds 10 11 / 22 23, so the sums become 11 13 / 27 29: c00, c01, c10 and c11.
svg.text: The 4 sums grow by 2 outer products in each phase.
Highlighted: values thread (0, 0) reads; gray: tile values that other threads read.
After phase 1 the 4 sums are c00 = 11, c01 = 13, c10 = 27 and c11 = 29.
